tool.help:
**What it does**
`rgoslin` parses and normalizes lipid shorthand nomenclature according to the **Grammar of Succinct Lipid Nomenclature (Goslin)** framework.
**Input**
A tabular file containing a column of lipid names. The user selects the column containing lipid shorthand names and specifies whether the first row contains column headers.
**Output**
It attempts to parse lipid names across multiple lipid nomenclature dialects (Goslin, SwissLipids, LIPID MAPS, HMDB, Shorthand2020, and FattyAcids) and uses the first successful parsing result.
The tool always generates a summary output. An optional full output containing all generated structural and fatty acid position-level annotations can also be generated.
1. **Summary Annotations:** Contains core metadata fields (`Normalized.Name`, `Grammar`, `Message`, `Lipid.Maps.Category`, `Lipid.Maps.Main.Class`, `Species.Name`, `Molecular.Species.Name`, `Level`, `Total.C`, `Total.DB`, `Mass`, `Sum.Formula`). 2. **Full Annotations:** Contains all generated structural and fatty acid position level details.
